name: Business License Tax
notes: An annual tax on a person engaged in business in the city, measured by the code's employee schedule or by dwelling units, not by gross receipts, except for the reduced schedule when gross income is between $1,000 and $2,500. Amounts below are the amounts printed in chapter 5.12, including the separate other-business employee schedule in section 5.12.010(D). They are not the community services and facilities tax in chapter 3.06, which the city may bill on the same license. Section 5.12.060 caps the total under section 5.12.010 at $500 for one location, and the total under the apartment, hotel, and trailer-park sections at $350. Section 5.12.070 lets the council increase the fees after a 10% rise in the San Francisco Bay Area CPI; no resolution adopting an increase was opened. Home occupations at or under $1,000 of gross receipts are sent to section 5.16.010, which was not opened. The 2024 ACFR reports $429,993 in business-license tax revenue for the year ended June 30, 2024. The FY2025-26 budget repeats that amount in its FY2023-24 Actual column under General Fund revenue. Neither document isolates license administration costs or attributes particular expenditures to this tax.
